title: Docsbook Skill Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file in the docs-skills catalog.

description.description: Short human-readable description used for discovery and AI matching.

requires_docsbook_mcp.description: True only for skills that genuinely need the Docsbook platform (e.g. workspace configuration, webhooks). Analysis/read skills must NOT set this — they state a need and work on any docs folder; declare optional accelerators via `accelerated_by` instead.

accelerated_by.description: Optional, NON-gating list of tools that make the skill faster/cheaper when connected (e.g. markdown-lsp, docsbook-mcp). The skill still works without them via plain file reads / grep / find. Entries are bare tool names; inline YAML comments are allowed.

requires_plan.description: Minimum Docsbook plan required to use this skill.

uses_mcp_tools.description: List of Docsbook MCP tool names the skill calls.

produces_files.description: Files the skill writes or modifies in the user's repo.

output_schema.description: URL of a JSON Schema the skill's machine-readable output conforms to.

pipeline_subagents.description: Names of pinned subagents this skill orchestrates, in pipeline order.

keywords.description: Discovery keywords used by find_skill matching.
